## Contribution

Link the task or research strand and name the main intellectual addition. Identify the target tenets or claims.

## Reasoning and dependencies

Summarise the argument or result. Separate inherited premises, new assumptions, and conclusions. Link reused reports and primary sources.

## Deliberation

Record actual reviews or responses, the strongest unresolved objection, and what changed. Mark an unreviewed contribution visibly.

## Book and core impact

Identify affected passages. If changing a core statement, link the explicit amendment with old and proposed wording. Explain whether a dependency now needs review.

## Attribution and verification

Credit substantive contributors and AI assistance. Report only checks, proofs, experiments, or tool runs that actually occurred, with their scope and limitations.
